name: N Candles v6
summary: This EA identifies and trades based on N consecutive bullish or bearish candles (candlestick streaks) as a momentum exhaustion or continuation signal. It enters positions when a configurable number of consecutive same-direction candles are detected, aiming to capitalize on short-term overextension or trend persistence. The strategy includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于N根连续看涨或看跌K线（K线连击）作为动量耗尽或延续信号进行交易。当检测到可配置数量的同方向连续K线时入场，旨在利用短期过度延伸或趋势持续性获利。策略包含基本的止损和止盈风险管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线连击形态识别，即当出现N根连续的同色K线（全部看涨或全部看跌）时视为交易信号。入场条件为：当检测到指定数量的连续看涨K线时做空（假设动量耗尽），或检测到指定数量的连续看跌K线时做多（假设超卖反弹），也可选择顺势入场。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，可能还包含K线形态反转的动态出场逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，止损和止盈的比例关系决定了单笔风险回报比，但该策略缺乏对整体账户风险的动态控制。该EA的核心假设是连续K线代表市场极端状态，随时可能回归或突破，但这种假设在不同市场条件下表现差异极大。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on consecutive candle streak identification, treating N same-direction candles in a row as a trading signal. Entry conditions: the EA enters a short position when N consecutive bullish candles are detected (assuming momentum exhaustion) or a long position when N consecutive bearish candles are detected (assuming oversold bounce), with an option for trend-following entries instead. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, potentially supplemented by candlestick pattern reversal exit logic. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity percentage-based calculation. Money management is governed by the stop loss to take profit ratio which determines the risk-reward profile per trade, but the strategy lacks dynamic account-level risk control. The core assumption is that consecutive candles represent market extremes prone to reversal or breakout, but this assumption performs very differently across varying market conditions.

parameters.name: ReverseMode
parameters.description: 是否反转入场（连续看涨做空）
parameters.description_en: Reverse entry: sell on consecutive bullish candles

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和调优
K线连击形态在强趋势市场中具有较好的识别能力
参数较少，回测和优化过程相对简洁高效
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and tune
Candle streak patterns have good identification capability in strong trending markets
Few parameters make backtesting and optimization relatively straightforward and efficient
cons: 连续K线形态在震荡市中容易产生大量虚假信号
缺乏市场环境过滤机制（如波动率、趋势强度等）
固定止损止盈无法适应不同市场波动率环境，容易在低波动时止损过宽或高波动时止盈过近
cons_en: Consecutive candle patterns generate many false signals in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks market environment filtering mechanisms (volatility, trend strength, etc.)
Fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to varying market volatility — stops may be too wide in low volatility or take profit too close in high volatility
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），仅在有利市场环境下交易
加入K线实体大小过滤，避免在微小实体连击时入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to only trade in favorable market conditions
Incorporate candle body size filtering to avoid entering on streaks of very small-bodied candles

risk_points: 固定止损止盈在市场波动率剧变时风险控制不足
缺乏账户整体风险监控，可能在极端行情中连续亏损
未对交易时段进行过滤，低流动性时段滑点风险增大
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP provides insufficient risk control during sudden volatility changes
Lacks account-level risk monitoring, risking consecutive losses during extreme market conditions
No trading session filter increases slippage risk during low liquidity periods

The strategy includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
